name: DiscountingMethod
description: A data defining:  discounting information. The 2000 ISDA definitions, section 8.4. discounting (related to the calculation of a discounted fixed amount or floating amount) apply. This type must only be included if discounting applies.

discountingType.description: The discounting method that is applicable.

discountRate.description: A discount rate, expressed as a decimal, to be used in the calculation of a discounted amount. A discount amount of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

discountRateDayCountFraction.description: A discount day count fraction to be used in the calculation of a discounted amount.
